title: thlaspi ruderale
intro: Thlaspi ruderale, commonly known as field pennycress, is a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a cool-season annual plant, native to Europe and Asia, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of field pennycress include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, likely due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Thlaspi ruderale include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
